discovery_method: kb_gap_audit.py pipeline + batch L4 (l4_batch_ffmpeg.py gap_likely) + manual L4: OH vf_hqdn3d.c lacks even the master-era EINVAL guard (67-line drift vs master pre-fix), config_input allocates line buffers by link width while do_denoise runs by frame dimensions

public_upstream.fix_subject: avfilter/vf_hqdn3d: support dynamic frame sizes (also whitelists hqdn3d in ff_filter_frame)

oh_source.equivalence: vf_hqdn3d.c AND avfilter.c both byte-identical to upstream n7.1.1
oh_source.l4_evidence: 7.1.1 filter_frame has no size check at all (upstream added an EINVAL guard only after 7.1.1, then full dynamic support in the fix); config_input allocates s->line[i] = av_malloc_array(inlink->w) while do_denoise uses AV_CEIL_RSHIFT(in->width/height)

vulnerability.summary: hqdn3d denoise line buffers are allocated for the configured link width, but denoise runs with the frame's own dimensions; a frame with larger dimensions writes past the line buffers (heap OOB write).
vulnerability.trigger: push a larger frame through a graph containing hqdn3d; direct trigger via buffersrc pass-through (no link mutation needed — more natural than CVE-2026-66041)
vulnerability.assert_caveat: default builds abort earlier at the ff_filter_frame av_assert1 (also a crash); --assert-level=0 (oss-fuzz condition) reaches the OOB write
vulnerability.verification_level: runtime-verified 2x2 matrix (2026-09-21): orig trigger -> ASan heap-buffer-overflow WRITE size 2 at denoise_spatial vf_hqdn3d.c:98 into the 128-byte (64*int16) config_input:269 allocation, exit 1; patched (narrow EINVAL guard) trigger -> clean reject exit 0; control identical on both

controls.name: constant-size
controls.desc: same-size frames: filter output identical on original and patched (no regression)
